+-------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                   | **Neostigmine **                                                                                         | **Sugammadex**                                                                                                                                |
+===================+==========================================================================================================+===============================================================================================================================================+
| **Class**         | Quaternary amine                                                                                         | Gamma cyclodextrin                                                                                                                            |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
| **Use**           | Reversal of residual non-depolarising muscle relaxant                                                    | Reversal of rocuronium and vecuronium blockade                                                                                                |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
| **Pharmaceutics** | Clear Colourless solution                                                                                | Clear Colourless solution                                                                                                                     |
+-------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Mechanism **    | Reversible inhibition of acetylcholinesterase (and plasma cholinesterase) →↑ACh in NMJ                   | Donut shaped molecule forms complexes with Roc/vec molecule and inactivates them in plasma → concentration gradient to remove  NDMR from NMJ  |
+-------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Dose**          | 0.05mg/kg to max ceiling effect or 0.07mg/kg. Co-administered with anti-muscarinic → prevent bradycardia | For rocuronium:                                                                                                                               |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   |                                                                                                          | TOF 2 → 2mg Kg                                                                                                                                |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   |                                                                                                          | TOF \<2 → 4mg/kg                                                                                                                              |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   |                                                                                                          | For reversal shortly after administration of large dose of Roc → 16mg/kg                                                                      |
+-------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **PK**            | Peak Effect 8min                                                                                         | Confined to plasma                                                                                                                            |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   | Duration 30-60min                                                                                        | Selectivity for Rocuronium\>Vecuronium, minimal action with pancuronium                                                                       |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   | Low PO bioavailability                                                                                   | No protein binding                                                                                                                            |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   | Low protein binding                                                                                      | No Metabolised                                                                                                                                |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   | Low Vd                                                                                                   | Excreted unchanged in urine (as complex)                                                                                                      |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   | 50% Metabolised by plasma esterase’s and hepatically                                                     |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
|                   | 50% Excreted unchanged in urine                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
+-------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

|                   |                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                               |
